text.text_excerpt: WOOP! Bourbon Vieux is definitely a great venue if you are looking to rent a private space for a party of celebration. One of the companies we've worked with hosted a conference party at Bourbon Vieux, and let me tell you I had a blast here. The venue is pretty big, I thought the music that was playing was awesome, and the best part is, you get an exclusive BALCONY on one of the hottest streets in New Orleans. Especially on a Friday night, you'll get a front row seat of all the action that happens in the Big Easy. Another great thing is that the venue is in the middle of the French Quarter. When looking for a wedding venue a few years ago, we found Bourbon Vieux. At that time, they seemed a bit unorganized and I also experienced the "run around" with trying to get in and see someone about renting the place. In the end, we opted for another place. Fast forward three years and I'm in town with friends for New Years Eve and the Bourbon Vieux came up as one of many places hosting NYE parties. For 165 bucks, they were offering a open bar and all you can eat buffet from 8PM to 1AM. Pros: Great Location Clean restrooms They poured some good top shelf liquors The food was really good. I had my wedding here the last weekend of July.. let me tell you, if I could do it again and again every year I would! This venue was not only spacious but the team and staff made it amazingly beautiful! I couldn't be happier with how the entire experience went. Courtney Shinn was awesome and so easy to deal with.. And the staff at the venue couldn't have been better. Jamie and Shannon especially. No one ever waited for a drink and everyone ate whenever they chose to. The food!! Omg, the food was so amazing!
